**MERGED.** Change 1924 patch set 2 landed on main as `b3d25d2aa0` at LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 with zero unresolved comments, submitted via plain Gerrit Submit (server-side rebase).

Verified on the merged tree: `signing.py` **435**, `_signing_manifest.py` **216**, `_signing_hmac.py` **276** — every file inside the 200-500 target band, and 365 lines of headroom on signing.py where there were 0.

Note on the earlier Verified-1: that was cast against patch set 1 and was a CANCELLED run (my patch-set-2 push superseded the in-flight job) — Gerrit's own message labelled it `CANCELLED (not a test verdict)`. No recheck was issued and no flaky test was retried; patch set 2 got a clean Verified +1 on its own run. The duplicate change 1926 remains abandoned.

All acceptance criteria met.
